rules.source: The Fund holds between 18 and 22 equally weighted positions selected from the investment universe.
No single holding may exceed 7% of the portfolio
no more than 15% of the portfolio may be invested in any one sector
The portfolio is spread across at least eight sectors.
The Fund invests only in companies domiciled in the Nordic region or Western Europe.
No more than 25% of the portfolio may be invested in companies from a single country.
Companies with a market capitalisation below EUR 1 billion are not eligible.
The Fund does not invest in companies involved in the production of tobacco or in controversial weapons.
Companies that derive more than 5% of their revenue from thermal coal are excluded.
rules.note: The thermal_coal flag is taken to mark companies above the 5% revenue threshold.

rules.source: Within each sector, the companies whose ESG score falls in the lowest 20% of that sector are not eligible for investment.
The average ESG score of the portfolio must be at least 5% higher than the average of the investment universe.
The portfolio's average carbon intensity must be at least 25% below that of the investment universe.
On average, women must make up at least 34% of the board members of portfolio companies.
At least half of the portfolio is invested in companies with validated science-based emissions reduction targets.
The Fund aims to reduce the carbon intensity of the portfolio by 7% each year.
rules.reason: A target that changes from year to year needs a time series of carbon data and a reference year; the spec describes one point in time.

rules.source: The expected tracking error of the portfolio against the investment universe will not exceed 6% per year.
At least 80% of the Fund's assets will be invested in companies whose activities are aligned with the EU Taxonomy.
rules.reason: The universe data has no EU Taxonomy alignment flag or field.

rules.source: The manager votes at all shareholder meetings and engages with investee companies on their climate transition plans.
rules.reason: Voting and engagement commitments do not restrict which assets may be held.
